in_hebrew.name: בנימין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בנימין הוא שם פרטי עברי שפירושו 'בן-ימין' או 'בנו של ימין'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'בן' שפירושו בן, ו'ימין' שפירושו ימין או דרום. השם בנימין הוא אחד משנים עשר בניו של יעקב אבינו, והוא נולד לא רחל ולא בלה, אחותה של רחל. בנימין היה אחיו הצעיר של יוסף ואהוד, והוא נחשב לאחד האבות של שבטי ישראל.

in_greek.name: Βενιαμίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Βενιαμίν (Βeniamín) σημαίνει 'υἱὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς' ἤ 'παῖς τοῦ Βενιαμίν'. Ὁ Βενιαμίν εἰς τὴν Καινήν Διαθήκην ἀναφέρεται ὡς υἱὸς τοῦ Ἰακώβ καὶ τῆς Ραχὴλ καὶ ἀδελφὸς τοῦ Ἰωσήφ. Ἐν Ἑβραϊκῇ, τὸ ὄνομα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὰς λέξεις 'בנ' (בן) σημαῖνον 'υἱός' καὶ 'ימין' (ימן) σημαῖνον 'δεξιὰ' ἢ 'Νότος'.

in_latin.name: Beniamin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Beniamin significat 'Filius dexterae' vel 'Beniamin', id est filius manūs dextrae. Nomen hoc hebraicum est et in Biblia sacra mentione habet, scilicet Beniamin fuit filius Jacob et Rachel, ac frater Joseph. Ecclesia Christiana primitiva hoc nomen usitavit ut signum benedictionis et gratiae Dei.

in_english.name: Benjamen
in_english.meaning: Son of the right hand, born on the right side
in_english.long_meaning: The name Benjamen originates from the Hebrew name 'בנימין' (Binyamin), which means 'son of the right hand' or 'born on the right side'. The name is composed of two Hebrew words: 'ben' meaning 'son' and 'yamin' meaning 'right hand' or 'south'. In the Bible, Benjamin was the youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, and the brother of Joseph. The name Benjamen has been used in Christian tradition to signify strength, favor, and divine blessing. Throughout history, the name has been popularized in various Christian cultures, often symbolizing a cherished or favored child.

The name Benjamin is also symbolic of protection, as the Bible states that Jacob named his son Benjamin after God said, "Son of my right hand, [he shall] become a tribesman in the midst of his brothers" (Genesis 48:20). The right hand is often associated with strength and power, emphasizing the spiritual and emotional support one can gain from their faith. Ultimately, the name Benjamin is a testament to the power of God and the blessings He bestows upon His chosen ones.
